Gabriel (peace be upon him) said, "We are more aware of who is in it; We will surely save him and his family, except his wife; she was of those who remained behind."
32.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 374

35.ar: یَا هِشَامُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تبارک وتعالی بَشَّرَ أَهْلَ الْعَقْلِ وَ الْفَهْمِ فِی کِتَابِهِ ... ثُمَّ خَوَّفَ الَّذِینَ لَا یَعْقِلُونَ عِقَابَهُ فَقَالَ تَعَالَی ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا الْآخَرِینَ* وَ إِنَّکُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَیْهِمْ مُصْبِحِینَ* وَ بِاللَّیْلِ أَ فَلا تَعْقِلُونَ. وَ قَالَ إِنَّا مُنْزِلُونَ عَلی أَهْلِ هذِهِ الْقَرْیَةِ رِجْزاً مِنَ السَّماءِ بِما کانُوا یَفْسُقُونَ* وَ لَقَدْ تَرَکْنا مِنْها آیَةً بَیِّنَةً لِقَوْمٍ یَعْقِلُونَ.
35.en: O Hisham! Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, has given glad tidings to the people of intellect and understanding in His Book... Then, He warned those who do not use their intellect of His punishment, saying, Exalted is He: "Then We destroyed the others. And indeed, you pass by them in the morning, and by night; will you not then use your intellect?" And He said: "Indeed, We will bring down upon the people of this city a punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient. And We have certainly left of it a sign as a clear evidence for a people who use their intellect."
35.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 376

38.ar: وَ أَمَّا الرَّدُّ عَلَی الْمُجَبِّرَةِ الَّذِینَ قَالُوا لَیْسَ لَنَا صُنْعٌ وَ نَحْنُ مُجْبَرُونَ یُحْدِثُ اللَّهُ لَنَا الْفِعْلَ عِنْدَ الْفِعْلِ وَ إِنَّمَا الْأَفْعَالُ هِیَ مَنْسُوبَةٌ إِلَی النَّاسِ عَلَی الْمَجَازِ لَا عَلَی الْحَقِیقَةِ وَ تَأَوَّلُوا فِی ذَلِکَ آیَاتٍ مِنْ کِتَابِ اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ لَمْ یَعْرِفُوا مَعْنَاهَا مِثْلَ قَوْلِهِ وَ ما تَشاؤُنَ إِلَّا أَنْ یَشاءَ اللهُ وَ قَوْلِهِ فَمَنْ یُرِدِ اللهُ أَنْ یَهْدِیَهُ یَشْرَحْ صَدْرَهُ لِلْإِسْلامِ وَ مَنْ یُرِدْ أَنْ یُضِلَّهُ یَجْعَلْ صَدْرَهُ ضَیِّقاً حَرَجاً وَ غَیْرِ ذَلِکَ مِنَ الْآیَاتِ الَّتِی تَأْوِیلُهَا عَلَی خِلَافِ مَعَانِیهَا وَ فِیمَا قَالُوهُ إِبْطَالُ الثَّوَابِ وَ الْعِقَابِ وَ إِذَا قَالُوا ذَلِکَ ثُمَّ أَقَرُّوا بِالثَّوَابِ وَ الْعِقَابِ نَسَبُوا اللَّهَ إِلَی الْجَوْرِ وَ أَنَّهُ یُعَذِّبُ عَلَی غَیْرِ اکْتِسَابٍ وَ فِعْلٍ تَعَالَی اللَّهُ عَنْ ذَلِکَ عُلُوّاً کَبِیراً أَنْ یُعَاقِبَ أَحَداً عَلَی غَیْرِ فِعْلٍ وَ بِغَیْرِ حُجَّةٍ وَاضِحَةٍ عَلَیْهِ وَ الْقُرْآنُ کُلُّهُ رَدٌّ عَلَیْهِمْ قَالَ اللَّهُ تبارک وتعالی ... وَ عاداً وَ ثَمُودَ وَ قَدْ تَبَیَّنَ لَکُمْ مِنْ مَساکِنِهِمْ وَ زَیَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّیْطانُ أَعْمالَهُمْ فَصَ-دَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّ-بِیلِ وَ کانُوا مُسْتَبْصِ-رِینَ* وَ قارُونَ وَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَ هامانَ وَ لَقَ-دْ جاءَهُمْ مُوسی بِالْبَیِّناتِ فَاسْتَکْبَرُوا فِی الْأَرْضِ وَ ما کانُوا سابِقِینَ* فَکُلًّا أَخَذْنا بِذَنْبِهِ فَلَمْ یَقُلْ بِفِعْلِنَا فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنا عَلَیْهِ حاصِباً وَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَخَذَتْهُ الصَّیْحَةُ وَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ خَسَفْنا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ وَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَغْرَقْنا وَ ما کانَ اللهُ لِیَظْلِمَهُمْ وَ لکِنْ کانُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ یَظْلِمُون.
38.en: As for the refutation of the Jabriyyah (determinists) who said, "We have no agency and we are compelled; it is Allah who creates the action for us at the moment of the act, and actions are only attributed to people metaphorically, not in reality," they have misinterpreted verses from the Book of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, whose meanings they did not understand, such as His saying: "And you do not will except that Allah wills," and His saying: "And whoever Allah wants to guide, He expands his chest to Islam; and whoever He wants to misguide, He makes his chest tight and constricted," and other verses whose correct interpretation is contrary to their apparent meanings. In what they claim lies the invalidation of reward and punishment. When they say this, and then acknowledge reward and punishment, they attribute injustice to Allah, claiming that He punishes without [the person having] committed an act or deed. Allah is far exalted above that—that He would punish anyone without an act [committed by them] and without a clear argument against them. The entire Quran is a refutation of them. Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, says: "...And [He destroyed] 'Aad and Thamud, and it has become clear to you from their dwellings. And Satan had made their deeds pleasing to them and averted them from the path, and they were endowed with insight. And [He destroyed] Qarun, Pharaoh, and Haman. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, but they were arrogant in the land, and they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. So each We seized for his sin; among them were those upon whom We sent a storm of stones, and among them were those who were seized by the blast [from the sky], and among them were those whom We caused the earth to swallow, and among them were those whom We drowned. And Allah would not have wronged them, but it was they who were wronging themselves."
38.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 376
38.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 5, p. 28; Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 1; "So each... wronging themselves" is omitted.

38.ar: عَبْدِ الْعَزِیزِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: کُنَّا فِی أَیَّامِ عَلِیِّ بْنِ مُوسَی الرِّضَا (علیه السلام) بِمَرْوَ فَاجْتَمَعْنَا فِی مَسْجِدِ جَامِعِهَا فِی یَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ فِی بَدْءِ مَقْدَمِنَا فَإِذَا رَأَی النَّاسُ أَمْرَ الْإِمَامَةِ وَ ذَکَرُوا کَثْرَةَ اخْتِلَافِ النَّاسِ فِیهَا فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَی سَیِّدِی وَ مَوْلَائِیَ الرِّضَا (علیه السلام) فَأَعْلَمْتُهُ مَا خَاضَ النَّاسُ فِیهِ فَتَبَسَّمَ (علیه السلام) ثُمَّ قَالَ یَا عَبْدَ الْعَزِیزِ جَهِلَ الْقَوْمُ وَ خُدِعُوا عَنْ أَدْیَانِهِمْ ... الْإِمَامُ وَاحِدُ دَهْرِهِ لَا یُدَانِیهِ أَحَدٌ وَ لَا یُعَادِلُهُ عَالِمٌ وَ لَا یُوجَدُ مِنْهُ بَدَلٌ وَ لَا لَهُ مِثْلٌ وَ لَا نَظِیرٌ مَخْصُوصٌ بِالْفِعْلِ کُلِّهِ مِنْ غَیْرِ طَلَبٍ مِنْهُ لَهُ وَ لَا اکْتِسَابٍ بَلِ اخْتِصَاصٌ مِنَ الْمُفْضِلِ الْوَهَّابِ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِی یَبْلُغُ مَعْرِفَةَ الْإِمَامِ وَ یُمْکِنُهُ اخْتِیَارُهُ هَیْهَاتَ هَیْهَاتَ ضَلَّتِ الْعُقُولُ وَ تَاهَتِ الْحُلُومُ وَ حَارَتِ الْأَلْبَابُ وَ حَسَرَتِ الْعُیُونُ وَ تَصَاغَرَتِ الْعُظَمَاءُ وَ تَحَیَّرَتِ الْحُکَمَاءُ وَ تَقَاصَرَتِ الْحُلَمَاءُ وَ حَصِرَتِ الْخُطَبَاءُ وَ جَهِلَتِ الْأَلِبَّاءُ وَ کَلَّتِ الشُّعَرَاءُ وَ عَجَزَتِ الْأُدَبَاءُ وَ عَیِیَتِ الْبُلَغَاءُ عَنْ وَصْفِ شَأْنٍ مِنْ شَأْنِهِ أَوْ فَضِیلَةٍ مِنْ فَضَائِلِهِ فَأَقَرَّتْ بِالْعَجْزِ وَ التَّقْصِیرِ وَ کَیْفَ یُوصَفُ لَهُ أَوْ یُنْعَتُ بِکُنْهِهِ أَوْ یُفْهَمُ شَیْءٌ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ أَوْ یُوجَدُ مَنْ یُقَامُ مَقَامَهُ وَ یُغْنِی غِنَاهُ لَا کَیْفَ وَ أَنَّی وَ هُوَ بحیت {بِحَیْثُ} النَّجْمُ مِنْ أَیْدِی الْمُتَنَاوِلِینَ وَ وَصْفِ الْوَاصِفِینَ فَأَیْنَ الِاخْتِیَارُ مِنْ هَذَا وَ أَیْنَ الْعُقُولُ عَنْ هَذَا وَ أَیْنَ یُوجَدُ مِثْلُ هَذَا أَ ظَنُّوا أَنْ یُوجَدَ ذَلِکَ فِی غَیْرِ آلِ الرَّسُولِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) کَذَبَتْهُمْ وَ اللَّهِ أَنْفُسُهُمْ وَ مَنَّتْهُمُ الْبَاطِلَ فَارْتَقَوْا مُرْتَقًی صَعْبا دَحْضاً تَزِلُّ عَنْهُ إِلَی الْحَضِیضِ أَقْدَامُهُمْ رَامُوا إِقَامَةَ الْإِمَامِ بِعُقُولٍ جائرة {حَائِرَةٍ} بَائِرَةٍ نَاقِصَةٍ وَ آرَاءٍ مُضِلَّةٍ فَلَمْ یَزْدَادُوا مِنْهُ إِلَّا بُعْداً قاتَلَهُمُ اللهُ أَنَّی یُؤْفَکُونَ لَقَدْ رَامُوا صَعْباً وَ قَالُوا إِفْکاً وَ ضَلُّوا ضَلالًا بَعِیداً وَ وَقَعُوا فِی الْحَیْرَةِ إِذْ تَرَکُوا الْإِمَامَ عَنْ بَصِیرَةٍ وَ زَیَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّیْطانُ أَعْمالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِیلِ وَ مَا کَانُوا مُسْتَبْصِرِینَ وَ رَغِبُوا عَنِ اخْتِیَارِ اللَّهِ وَ اخْتِیَارِ رَسُولِهِ إِلَی اخْتِیَارِهِم.
38.en: Abd al-Aziz ibn Muslim said: "We were in Merv during the time of Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him). We gathered in the congregational mosque on a Friday at the beginning of our arrival, and the people were discussing the matter of the Imamate and mentioning the great disagreement among people regarding it. I entered upon my master and patron, al-Rida (peace be upon him), and informed him of what the people were debating. He smiled (peace be upon him) and then said: 'O Abd al-Aziz, the people have been ignorant and deceived regarding their religions... The Imam is the unique one of his age; no one can approach him, no scholar can equal him, and there is no substitute for him, nor does he have a likeness or a peer. He is distinguished by all his actions without seeking them or acquiring them; rather, it is a special favor from the Bestower, the Giver. Who is it that can attain the knowledge of the Imam or is able to choose him? Far, far from it! Intellects have gone astray, minds have wandered, thoughts have been bewildered, eyes have been exhausted, the great have been humbled, the wise have been perplexed, the prudent have fallen short, the orators have been silenced, the intelligent have been ignorant, the poets have faltered, the writers have been rendered incapable, and the eloquent have been unable to describe even one of his stations or one of his virtues. They have all confessed their inability and shortcoming. How can he be described, or his essence defined, or anything of his affair understood, or someone found who can stand in his place and suffice as he suffices? How and where? He is like a star beyond the reach of those who seek it and the description of those who describe it. Where, then, is the choice in this? Where are the intellects regarding this? And where can the like of this be found? Do they think that such a thing can be found in other than the family of the Messenger (peace be upon him and his family)? By Allah, their own selves have lied to them, and they have been promised vanity. They have ascended a difficult and slippery path, from which their feet will slide down to the abyss. They have sought to establish the Imam with bewildered, worthless, and deficient intellects and misleading opinions, so they have only increased in distance from him. May Allah destroy them! How are they deluded? They have sought a difficult task, spoken a lie, and gone far astray. They have fallen into confusion because they abandoned the Imam with insight, and Satan made their deeds fair-seeming to them, barring them from the path, even though they were endowed with insight. They turned away from the choice of Allah and the choice of His Messenger toward their own choice.'"
38.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 378

38.ar: بَعدَ أن ذَکَرَ الشَّیطَانِ:ٍ وَ لَا یَغُرَّنَّکَ تَزْیِینُهُ الطَّاعَاتِ عَلَیْکَ فَإِنَّهُ یَفْتَحُ لَکَ تِسْعَةً وَ تِسْعِینَ بَاباً مِنَ الْخَیْرِ لِیَظْفَرَ بِکَ عِنْدَ تَمَامِ الْمِائَةِ فَقَابِلْهُ بِالْخِلَافِ وَ الصَّدِّ عَنْ سَبِیلِهِ وَ الْمُضَادَّةِ بِاسْتِهْزَائِه.
38.fa: و چون شیطان طاعات و اعمال تو را تزیین بنماید، هرگز مغرور و فریفته مباش، زیرا ممکن است نودونه باب از خیر و نیکویی را به روی تو بازکند، و پس از نودونه امر در قدم صدم کار خود را صورت بدهد. پس در مخالفت او پیوسته برقرار باش، و راه نفوذ و فریب او را بگیر، و با میل و هوی‌خواهی و مقاصد او مبارزه کن.
38.en: After mentioning the devil: Do not be deceived by his embellishment of acts of obedience for you, for he may open ninety-nine doors of goodness for you in order to triumph over you at the completion of the hundredth. Therefore, confront him with opposition, by blocking his path, and by countering him with mockery.
38.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 380
38.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 69, p. 125; Nur al-Thaqalayn

38.ar: الْإِمَامُ کَلِمَةُ اللَّهِ وَ حُجَّةُ اللَّهِ وَ وَجْهُ اللَّهِ وَ نُورُ اللَّهِ وَ حِجَابُ اللَّهِ وَ آیَةُ اللَّهِ یَخْتَارُهُ اللَّهُ وَ یَجْعَلُ فِیهِ مَا یَشَاء ... وَ حِجَابُ اللَّهِ الْأَعْظَمُ الْأَعْلَی فَأَیْنَ الِاخْتِیَارُ مِنْ هَذَا وَ أَیْنَ الْعُقُولُ مِنْ هَذَا وَ مَنْ ذَا عَرَفَ أَوْ وَصَفَ مَنْ وَصَفْتُ ظَنُّوا أَنَّ ذَلِکَ فِی غَیْرِ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ (صلی الله علیه و آله) کَذَبُوا وَ زَلَّتْ أَقْدَامُهُمْ اتَّخَذُوا الْعِجْلَ رَبّاً وَ الشَّیَاطِینَ حِزْباً کُلُّ ذَلِکَ بِغْضَةً لِبَیْتِ الصَّفْوَةِ وَ دَارِ الْعِصْمَةِ وَ حَسَداً لِمَعْدِنِ الرِّسَالَةِ وَ الْحِکْمَةِ وَ زَیَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّیْطانُ أَعْمالَهُمْ فَتَبّاً لَهُمْ وَ سُحْقاً کَیْفَ اخْتَارُوا إِمَاماً جَاهِلًا عَابِداً لِلْأَصْنَامِ جَبَاناً یَوْمَ الزِّحَام.
38.fa: امام کلمهًْ اللَّه و حجّت اللَّه و وجه اللَّه و نور اللَّه و حجاب اللَّه و آیهًْ الله است خداوند انتخابش می‌کند و هر چه خواست در او قرار می‌دهد ... و آنها حجاب خداوند بزرگ و بلند مرتبهاند؟ چگونه می‌توان چنین شخصیّت‌هایی را با انتخاب تعیین نمود و کجا عقل‌ها می‌توانند آنها را درک کنند؟ آنها را که من توصیف نمودم چه کسی می‌تواند بشناسد یا وصف کند؟ خیال کردند چنین موقعیّت و مقامی می‌تواند در غیر آل محمّد باشد، دروغ گفتهاند و پایشان لغزیده است و گوساله را به خدائی پذیرفته‌اند و در گروه شیاطین وارد شدند. تمام این انحرافات به جهت بغضی بود که با آل محمّد (علیهم السلام) و خاندان عصمت داشتند و حسادتی که به معدن رسالت و حکمت میورزیدند. شیطان اعمالشان را زیبا جلوه داد، مرگ بر آنها باد و از خدا به دور باشند! چگونه امامی را انتخاب نمودند که نادان و بتپرست بود و در میان انبوه جنگاوران ترسو بود؟
38.en: The Imam is the Word of Allah, the Proof of Allah, the Face of Allah, the Light of Allah, the Veil of Allah, and the Sign of Allah. Allah chooses him and places within him whatever He wills... and they are the greatest and most exalted Veil of Allah. So where does [human] choice stand in relation to this, and where can intellects reach in relation to this? And who is it that can know or describe the one whom I have described? They imagined that such a position could exist in someone other than the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family); they have lied, and their feet have slipped. They took the calf as a lord and the devils as a party. All of this was out of hatred for the House of Purity and the Abode of Infallibility, and out of envy for the Mine of Messengership and Wisdom. Satan made their deeds appear fair to them; so woe to them and may they be cast far away! How could they choose an Imam who was ignorant, a worshipper of idols, and a coward on the day of battle?
38.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 380

39.ar: قَوْلُهُ وَ قارُونَ وَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَ هامانَ وَ لَقَدْ جاءَهُمْ إِلَی قَوْلِهِ سابِقِینَ فَهَذَا رَدٌّ عَلَی الْمُجَبِّرَةِ الَّذِینَ زَعَمُوا أَنَّ الْأَفْعَالَ لِلَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ وَ لَا صُنْعَ لَهُمْ فِیهَا وَ لَا اکْتِسَابَ فَرَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَیْهِمْ فَقَالَ فَکُلًّا أَخَذْنا بِذَنْبِهِ وَ لَمْ یَقُلْ بِفِعْلِنَا لِأَنَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ أَعْدَلُ مِنْ أَنْ یُعَذِّبَ الْعَبْدَ عَلَی فِعْلِهِ الَّذِی یُجْبِرُهُ عَلَیْهِ.
39.fa: وَقَارُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَلَقَدْ جَاءهُم مُّوسَی بِالْبَیِّنَاتِ فَاسْتَکْبَرُوا فِی الْأَرْضِ وَمَا کَانُوا سَابِقِینَ، این آیه باور جبریون را که گمان می‌کنند فاعل همه‌ی افعال خداوند عزّوجلّ است و آن‌ها هیچ نقشی و ثوابی در آن ندارند، باطل می‌کند؛ زیرا خداوند به آن‌ها پاسخ داده و می‌فرماید: فَکُلًّا أَخَذْنَا بِذَنبِهِ و نفرمود: بِفِعلِنَا به؛ زیرا خدای عزّوجلّ عادل‌تر از آن است که بنده‌اش را به خاطر فعلش که او را مجبور به انجام آن کرده، عذاب‌دهد.
39.en: Regarding His saying: "And Qarun, and Pharaoh, and Haman; and indeed Moses came to them..." up to His saying: "...and they were not able to outstrip [Us]." This is a refutation of the Jabriyyah (determinists) who claim that all actions belong to Allah (Mighty and Majestic is He) and that they have no creation of them nor acquisition. Allah refuted them by saying: "So each We seized for his sin," and He did not say "for Our action," because He (Mighty and Majestic is He) is too just to punish a servant for an action that He forced him to perform.
39.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 380

39.ar: ثُمَّ قَالَ {ابوذر (رحمة الله علیه)} أَ لَسْتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ص قَالَ شَرُّ الْأَوَّلِینَ وَ الْآخِرِینَ اثْنَا عَشَرَ سِتَّةٌ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِینَ وَ سِتَّةٌ مِنَ الْآخِرِینَ ثُمَ سَمَّی السِّتَّةَ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِینَ ابْنَ آدَمَ الَّذِی قَتَلَ أَخَاهُ وَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَ هَامَانَ وَ قَارُونَ وَ السَّامِرِیَّ وَ الدَّجَّالَ اسْمُهُ فِی الْأَوَّلِینَ وَ یَخْرُجُ فِی الْآخِرِین.
39.fa: ابوذر (رحمة الله علیه) گوید: شما گواه نیستید که رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) فرمود: «بدترین مردم از اوّلین و آخرین دوازده نفر هستند: شش تن از پیشینیان و شش تن از متأخّرین؟ سپس شش نفر پیشینیان را چنین نام برد: فرزند آدم که برادرش را کشت، فرعون، هامان، قارون، سامری و دجّال که نامش در میان پیشینیان است ولی با متأخّرین خروج میکند».
39.en: Then Abu Dharr (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Do you not bear witness that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The worst of the first and the last are twelve: six from the first and six from the last'? Then he named the six from the first: the son of Adam who killed his brother, Pharaoh, Haman, Qarun, the Samiri, and the Dajjal, whose name is among the first, but who will emerge among the last."
39.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 380

39.ar: إِنَّ فِی التَّابُوتِ الْأَسْفَلِ مِنَ النَّارِ سِتَّةً مِنَ الْأَوَّلِینَ وَ سِتَّةً مِنَ الْآخِرِینَ، فَأَمَّا السِّتَّةُ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِینَ: فَابْنُ آدَمَ (علیه السلام) الَّذِی قَاتَلَ أَخِیهِ، وَ فِرْعَوْنُ الْفَرَاعِنَةِ، وَ السَّامِرِیُّ، وَ الدَّجَّالُ، کِتَابُهُ فِی الْأَوَّلِینَ، وَ یَخْرُجُ فِی الْآخِرِینَ وَ هَامَانُ، وَ قَارُون.
39.fa: در تابوت ته دوزخ شش نفر از امّت‌های پیشین جا دارند و شش نفر از امّت آخرالزّمان؛ اما آن شش نفر که از پیشینیان‌اند: فرزند آدم (علیه السلام) است که برادرش را کشت و فرعون فرعون‌ها است و سامری است و دجّال است که نامش در زمره‌ی پیشینیان است ولی در آخرالزّمان خروج خواهد کرد و هامان و قارون.
39.en: In the lowest casket of the Fire, there are six from the ancients and six from the latter ones. As for the six from the ancients: the son of Adam (peace be upon him) who killed his brother, the Pharaoh of Pharaohs, the Samiri, the Dajjal—whose record is among the ancients but who will emerge among the latter ones—Haman, and Qarun.
39.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 382
39.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 30, p. 409; Nur al-Thaqalayn

40.ar: فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنا عَلَیْهِ حاصِباً وَ هُمْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ (علیه السلام) وَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَخَذَتْهُ الصَّیْحَةُ وَ هُمْ قَوْمُ شُعَیْبٍ وَ صَالِحٍ (علیها السلام) وَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ خَسَفْنا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ وَ هُمْ قَوْمُ هُودٍ (علیه السلام) وَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَغْرَقْنا فِرْعَوْنُ وَ أَصْحَابُهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ تَأْکِیداً وَ رَدّاً عَلَی الْمُجَبِّرَةِ وَ ما کانَ اللهُ لِیَظْلِمَهُمْ وَ لکِنْ کانُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ یَظْلِمُونَ.
40.fa: فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنا عَلَیْهِ حاصِباً؛ آن‌ها قوم لوط (علیه السلام) بودند. وَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَخَذَتْهُ الصَّیْحَةُ؛ آن‌ها قوم شعیب (علیه السلام) و صالح (علیه السلام) بودند. وَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ خَسَفْنا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ؛ وآن‌ها قوم هود (علیه السلام) بودند. وَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَغْرَقْنا؛ آن‌ها فرعون و یارانش بودند. سپس خداوند عزّوجلّ در پاسخ به جبری مذهبان می‌فرماید: ما کانَ اللهُ لِیَظْلِمَهُمْ وَ لکِنْ کانُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ یَظْلِمُونَ.
40.en: "So among them were those upon whom We sent a storm of stones"—they were the people of Lot (peace be upon him). "And among them were those who were seized by the blast"—they were the people of Shu'ayb and Salih (peace be upon them). "And among them were those whom We caused the earth to swallow"—they were the people of Hud (peace be upon him). "And among them were those whom We drowned"—they were Pharaoh and his companions. Then, the Almighty and Exalted said, as an emphasis and a refutation against the predestinarians (Mujabbira): "And Allah would not have wronged them, but it was they who were wronging themselves."
40.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 382
40.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 11, p. 26 / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 152; "minhum man akhathathu... yazlimun" is omitted.

40.ar: أَمَّا الرَّدُّ عَلَی الْمُجَبِّرَةِ وَ هُمُ الَّذِینَ زَعَمُوا أَنَّ الْأَفْعَالَ إِنَّمَا هِیَ مَنْسُوبَةٌ إِلَی الْعِبَادِ مَجَازاً لَا حَقِیقَةً وَ إِنَّمَا حَقِیقَتُهَا لِلَّهِ لَا لِلْعِبَادِ وَ تَأَوَّلُوا فِی ذَلِکَ آیَاتٍ مِنْ کِتَابِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَی لَمْ یَعْرِفُوا مَعْنَاهَا کَمَا فِی قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَی وَ لَوْ شاءَ اللهُ ما أَشْرَکُوا فَرَدَّ عَلَیْهِمْ أَهْلُ الْحَقِّ فَقَالُوا لَهُمْ إِنَّ فِی قَوْلِکُمْ ذَلِکَ بُطْلَانَ الثَّوَابِ وَ الْعِقَابِ إِذَا نَسَبْتُمْ أَفْعَالَکُمْ إِلَی اللَّهِ تَعَالَی عَمَّا یَصِفُونَ وَ کَیْفَ یُعَاقِبُ مَخْلُوقاً عَلَی غَیْرِ فِعْلٍ مِنْهُ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی ... فَکُلًّا أَخَذْنا بِذَنْبِهِ إِلَی قَوْلِهِ وَ ما کانَ اللهُ لِیَظْلِمَهُمْ وَ لکِنْ کانُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ یَظْلِمُونَ وَ مِثْلُ هَذَا کَثِیرٌ فِی کِتَابِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَی وَ فِیهِ بُطْلَانُ مَا ادَّعَوْهُ وَ نَسَبُوهُ إِلَی اللَّهِ تَعَالَی أَنْ یَأْمُرَ خَلْقَهُ بِمَا لَا یَقْدِرُونَ أَوْ یَنْهَاهُمْ عَمَّا لَیْسَ فِیهِمْ صُنْعٌ وَ لَا اکْتِسَابٌ.
40.en: As for the refutation of the Mujabbirah (determinists), who claim that actions are only attributed to servants metaphorically and not in reality, and that their reality belongs to God and not to the servants—they have misinterpreted verses from the Book of God, the Exalted, whose meanings they did not understand, such as His saying, "If God had willed, they would not have associated partners [with Him]." The people of truth refuted them, saying: "In this claim of yours lies the invalidation of reward and punishment. If you attribute your actions to God, the Exalted—far is He above what they describe—how then would He punish a created being for an action that was not theirs?" God, the Exalted, said: "...So We seized each for their sin; among them were those upon whom We sent a storm of stones, and among them were those who were seized by the blast, and among them were those whom We caused the earth to swallow, and among them were those whom We drowned. And God would not have wronged them, but it was they who were wronging themselves." There are many such examples in the Book of God, the Exalted, which invalidate what they claim and attribute to God—that He would command His creation to do what they are not capable of, or forbid them from what they have no agency or acquisition in.
40.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 382

41.ar: تفسیر الإمام (علیه السلام) قَوْلُهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ إِنَّ اللهَ لایَسْتَحْیِی أَنْ یَضْرِبَ مَثَلًا ما بَعُوضَةً فَما فَوْقَها فَأَمَّا الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا فَیَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ وَ أَمَّا الَّذِینَ کَفَرُوا فَیَقُولُونَ ما ذا أَرادَ اللهُ بِهذا مَثَلًا یُضِلُّ بِهِ کَثِیراً وَ یَهْدِی بِهِ کَثِیراً وَ ما یُضِلُّ بِهِ إِلَّا الْفاسِقِینَ* الَّذِینَ یَنْقُضُونَ عَهْدَ اللهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مِیثاقِهِ وَ یَقْطَعُونَ ما أَمَرَ اللهُ بِهِ أَنْ یُوصَلَ وَ یُفْسِدُونَ فِی الْأَرْضِ أُولئِکَ هُمُ الْخاسِرُونَ قَالَ الْبَاقِرُ (علیه السلام) فَلَمَّا قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی یا أَیُّهَا النَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌ وَ ذَکَرَ الذُّبَابَ فِی قَوْلِهِ إِنَّ الَّذِینَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللهِ لَنْ یَخْلُقُوا ذُباباً وَ لَمَّا قَالَ مَثَلُ الَّذِینَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللهِ أَوْلِیاءَ کَمَثَلِ الْعَنْکَبُوتِ اتَّخَذَتْ بَیْتاً وَ إِنَّ أَوْهَنَ الْبُیُوتِ لَبَیْتُ الْعَنْکَبُوتِ لَوْ کانُوا یَعْلَمُونَ وَ ضَرَبَ الْمَثَلَ فِی هَذِهِ السُّورَةِ بِالَّذِی اسْتَوْقَدَ نَاراً وَ بِالصَّیِّبِ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ قَالَتِ النَّوَاصِبُ وَ الْکُفَّارُ وَ مَا هَذَا مِنَ الْأَمْثَالِ فَتُضْرَبَ یُرِیدُونَ بِهِ الطَّعْنَ عَلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله).
41.en:
In the Tafsir attributed to Imam Hasan al-Askari (peace be upon him), it is stated regarding the words of the Almighty: "Indeed, Allah is not timid to present an example - that of a mosquito or what is smaller than it. And those who have believed know that it is the truth from their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, they say, 'What did Allah intend by this as an example?' He misleads many thereby and guides many thereby. And He misleads not except the defiantly disobedient, who break the covenant of Allah after contracting it and sever that which Allah has ordered to be joined and cause corruption on earth. It is those who are the losers." (Al-Baqarah: 26-27).

Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) said: "When Allah the Almighty said, 'O people, an example is presented,' He mentioned the fly in His saying: 'Indeed, those you invoke besides Allah will never create [as much as] a fly.' (Al-Hajj: 73). And when He said: 'The example of those who take allies other than Allah is like that of the spider who takes a home. And indeed, the weakest of homes is the home of the spider, if they only knew.' And in this Surah [Al-Baqarah], He presented the example of the one who kindled a fire and the example of the rainstorm from the sky. After these examples which Allah presented to the people in the Quran, the Nasibis and the disbelievers said, 'What kind of examples are these to be presented?' intending by this to attack the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)."
41.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 384
41.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 388; Al-Imam al-Askari, p. 205; "His saying, the Almighty, 'Indeed Allah... then when Allah the Almighty said'" is omitted.

41.ar: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا فِیمَنِ اتَّخَذَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلِیّاً فَقَالَ مَثَلُ الَّذِینَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللهِ أَوْلِیاءَ کَمَثَلِ الْعَنْکَبُوتِ اتَّخَذَتْ بَیْتاً وَ هُوَ الَّذِی نَسَجَهُ الْعَنْکَبُوتُ عَلَی بَابِ الْغَارِ الَّذِی دَخَلَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ هُوَ أَوْهَنُ الْبُیُوتِ فَکَذَلِکَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلِیّا.
41.fa: خداوند مثل می‌زند در مورد کسانی‌که غیر خدا را به دوستی برگزیده‌اند مَثَلُ الَّذِینَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللهِ أَوْلِیاءَ کَمَثَلِ الْعَنْکَبُوتِ اتَّخَذَتْ بَیْتاً؛ این خانه همان تارهایی است که عنکبوت بر در غاری که پیامبر اکرم (صلی الله علیه و آله) وارد شد، تنید که سست‌ترین خانه‌هاست همین طور است هرکس غیر خدا، دیگری را به دوستی برگزیند.
41.en: Allah sets forth a parable regarding those who have taken protectors other than Allah, saying: "The likeness of those who take protectors other than Allah is as the likeness of the spider that builds a house." This house is the web that the spider spun over the entrance of the cave which the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) entered, and it is the weakest of houses. Likewise is the case of anyone who takes a protector other than Allah.
41.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 384
41.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 229; Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 148

41.ar: عَنْ ثَوْرِبْنِ سَعِیدٍ عَنْ سَعِیدِ بْنِ عِلَاقَةَ قَالَ سَمِعتُ أمِیرُالمُؤمِنِینَ (علیه السلام) یَقُولُ تَرکُ نَسجِ العَنکَبُوتِ فِی البَیتِ یُورِثُ الفَقرَ.
41.fa: سعیدبن‌علاقه گوید: از امیرالمؤمنین علیّ‌بن‌ابی‌طالب (علیه السلام) شنیدم که می‌فرمود: «پاک نکردن تار عنکبوت از خانه، فقر می آورد».
41.en: Thawr ibn Sa'id narrated from Sa'id ibn 'Alaqah, who said: I heard the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) saying: "Leaving spider webs in the house brings about poverty."
41.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 384

41.ar: الْمُسُوخُ مِنْ بَنِی آدَمَ ثَلَاثَةَ عَشَرَ، إِلَی أَنْ قَالَ: وَ أَمَّا الْعَنْکَبُوتُ فَکَانَتِ امْرَأَةً سَیِّئَةَ الْخُلُقِ عَاصِیَةً لِزَوْجِهَا مُوَلِّیَةً عَنْهُ فَمَسَخَهَا اللَّهُ عَنْکَبُوتاً.
41.fa: مسخ‌شده‌ها از بنی‌آدم سیزده صنف‌اند ... امّا عنکبوت؛ زنی بد اخلاق بود که شوهرش را نافرمانی می‌کرد و از او روی‌گردان بود، به همین خاطر خدای متعال او را به شکل عنکبوت مسخ کرد.
41.en: The metamorphosed ones among the children of Adam are thirteen [types], until he said: As for the spider, it was a woman of bad character who disobeyed her husband and turned away from him, so Allah metamorphosed her into a spider.
41.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 384

41.ar: ٍ عَنْ مُغِیرَةَ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) عَنْ أَبِیهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ (علیه السلام) قَال سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) عَنِ الْمُسُوخِ فَقَالَ هُمْ ثَلَاثَةَ عَشَر إلَی أن قَالَ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ أَمَّا الْعَنْکَبُوتُ فَکَانَتِ امْرَأَةً تَخُونُ زَوْجَهَا.
41.fa: مغیره از امام صادق (علیه السلام) و ایشان از پدرانشان نقل نمود که جدّشان فرمود: از پیامبر (صلی الله علیه و آله) پرسیدم: «حیوانات مسخ شده کدامند»؟ فرمود: «سیزده صنف هستند ... عنکبوت: زنی بود که به شوهرش خیانت می‌کرد.
41.en: Mughirah narrated from Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him), who narrated from his father, who narrated from his grandfather (peace be upon him), who said: I asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) about the metamorphosed creatures (al-musukh). He replied: "They are thirteen." He then said (peace be upon him and his family): "As for the spider, it was a woman who used to betray her husband."
41.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 384

41.ar: وَ أَمَّا الْعَنْکَبُوتُ فَکَانَتِ امْرَأَةً سَحَرَتْ زَوْجَهَا.
41.fa: امّا عنکبوت؛ زنی بود که شوهرش را سحر کرد.
41.en: As for the spider, it was a woman who cast a spell upon her husband.
41.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 384

41.ar: ِ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ مُکْرَمٍ عَنْ أَبِیهِ قَال سَمِعْتُ أَبَاجَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) یَقُولُ فِی قَوْلِهِ مَثَلُ الَّذِینَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللهِ أَوْلِیاءَ کَمَثَلِ الْعَنْکَبُوتِ اتَّخَذَتْ بَیْتاً قَالَ هِیَ الْحُمَیْرَاءُ.
41.fa: سالم‌بن‌مکرم گوید: از امام باقر (علیه السلام) که درباره‌ی آیه: مَثَلُ الْعَنکَبُوتِ اتَّخَذَتْ بَیْتًا وَإِنَّ أَوْهَنَ الْبُیُوتِ لَبَیْتُ الْعَنکَبُوتِ فرمود: «آن حمیراء است».
41.en: Salim ibn Mukarram narrated from his father, saying: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) say regarding the verse: "The example of those who take allies other than Allah is like that of the spider who takes a home," he said: "It is al-Humayra."
41.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 386
41.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 32, p. 286; Ta'wil al-Ayat al-Zahira, p. 421; [with slight variations]

43.ar: فِی مَجمَعِ البَیَان رَوَی الوَاحِدِی بِالإسنَادِ عَن جَابِر (رحمة الله علیه) قَالَ تَلَا النَّبِِیُّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) هَذِهِ الایَةَ وَ قَالَ العَالِمُ الَّذِی عَقَلَ عَنِ اللهِ فَعَمِلَ بِطَاعَتِهِ وَ اجتَنَبَ سَخَطَهُ.
43.fa: واحدی در «مجمع البیان» با سندش از جابر (رحمة الله علیه) آورده است: پیامبر (صلی الله علیه و آله) این آیه را تلاوت کرد و فرمود: «عالم کسی است که خداوند را دریابد پس اطاعت کند و از خشمش دوری کند».
43.en: In Majma' al-Bayan, al-Wahidi narrates with his chain of transmission from Jabir (may God have mercy on him) who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) recited this verse and said: "The scholar is one who understands [the command of] God, then acts in obedience to Him and avoids His wrath."
43.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 386

43.ar: عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ الْحَکَمِ قَالَ قَالَ لِی أَبُوالْحَسَنِ مُوسَی بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) یَا هِشَامُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تبارک وتعالی بَشَّرَ أَهْلَ الْعَقْلِ وَ الْفَهْمِ فِی کِتَابِه ... یَا هِشَامُ إِنَّ الْعَقْلَ مَعَ الْعِلْمِ فَقَالَ وَ تِلْکَ الْأَمْثالُ نَضْرِبُها لِلنَّاسِ وَ ما یَعْقِلُها إِلَّا الْعالِمُون.
43.fa: هشام‌بن‌حکم گوید: امام کاظم (علیه السلام) به من فرمود: ای هشام! خداوند به اهل عقل و فهم در کتاب خود بشارت داده است: ... ای هشام! عقل همراه دانش می‌باشد و فرموده است: وَ تِلْکَ الْأَمْثالُ نَضْرِبُها لِلنَّاسِ وَ ما یَعْقِلُها إِلَّا الْعالِمُون.
43.en: Hisham ibn al-Hakam said: Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja’far (peace be upon him) said to me: "O Hisham, indeed Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, has given glad tidings to the people of intellect and understanding in His Book... O Hisham, intellect is with knowledge, and He has said: 'And these examples We present to the people, but none will understand them except the knowledgeable.'"
43.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 386
43.refs: al-Kafi, Vol. 1, p. 13; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 1, p. 134; Tuhaf al-Uqul, p. 383

43.ar: عَنْ أَبِی بَصِیرٍ عَنْ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) أَنَّهُ قَال إِنَّ أَبَاذَرٍّ (رحمة الله علیه)کَانَ یَقُولُ یَا مُبْتَغِیَ الْعِلْمِ کَأَنَّ شَیْئاً مِنَ الدُّنْیَا لَمْ یَکُنْ شَیْئاً إِلَّا عَمَلًا یَنْفَعُ خَیْرُهُ وَ یَضُرُّ شَرُّهُ إِلَّا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ یَا مُبْتَغِیَ الْعِلْمِ لَا یَشْغَلْکَ أَهْلٌ وَ لَا مَالٌ عَنْ نَفْسِکَ أَنْتَ یَوْمَ تُفَارِقُهُمْ کَضَیْفٍ بِتَّ فِیهِمْ ثُمَّ غَدَوْتَ مِنْ عِنْدِهِمْ إِلَی غَیْرِهِمْ وَ الدُّنْیَا وَ الْآخِرَةُ کَمَنْزِلٍ نَزَلْتَهُ ثُمَّ عَدَلْتَ عَنْهُ إِلَی غَیْرِهِ وَ مَا بَیْنَ الْمَوْتِ وَ الْبَعْثِ إِلَّا کَنَوْمَةٍ نِمْتَهَا ثُمَّ اسْتَیْقَظْتَ مِنْهَا یَا مُبْتَغِیَ الْعِلْمِ قَدِّمْ لِمَقَامِکَ بَیْنَ یَدَیِ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّکَ مُرْتَهَنٌ بِعَمَلِکَ وَ کَمَا تَدِینُ تُدَانُ یَا مُبْتَغِیَ الْعِلْمِ صَلِّ قَبْلَ أَنْ لَا تَقْدِرَ عَلَی لَیْلٍ وَ لَا نَهَارٍ تُصَلِّی فِیهِ إِنَّمَا مَثَلُ الصَّلَاةِ لِصَاحِبِهَا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ کَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ دَخَلَ عَلَی سُلْطَانٍ فَأَنْصَتَ لَهُ حَتَّی فَرَغَ مِنْ حَاجَتِهِ کَذَلِکَ الْمَرْءُ الْمُسْلِمُ مَا دَامَ فِی صَلَاتِهِ لَمْ یَزَلِ اللَّهُ یَنْظُرُ إِلَیْهِ حَتَّی یَفْرُغَ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ یَا مُبْتَغِیَ الْعِلْمِ تَصَدَّقْ قَبْلَ أَنْ لَا تَقْدِرَ أَنْ تُعْطِیَ شَیْئاً وَ لَا تَمْنَعَ مِنْهُ إِنَّمَا مَثَلُ الصَّدَقَةِ لِصَاحِبِهَا کَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ طَلَبَهُ الْقَوْمُ بِدَمٍ فَقَالَ لَا تَقْتُلُونِی وَ اضْرِبُوا لِی أَجَلًا لِأَسْعَ-ی فِی مَرْضَاتِکُمْ کَذَلِ-کَ الْمَرْءُ الْمُسْلِمُ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ کُلَّمَا تَص-َدَّقَ بِصَدَقَةٍ حَلَّ بِهَا عُقْدَةً فِی رَقَبَتِهِ حَتَّی یَتَوَفَّی اللَّهُ أَقْوَاماً وَ قَدْ رَضِیَ عَنْهُمْ وَ مَنْ رَضِیَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ فَقَدْ عَتَقَ مِنَ النَّارِ یَا مُبْتَغِیَ الْعِلْمِ إِنَّ قَلْباً لَیْسَ مِنْهُ مِنَ الْحَقِّ شَیْءٌ کَالْبَیْتِ الْخَرَابِ الَّذِی لَا عَامِرَ لَهُ یَا مُبْتَغِیَ الْعِلْمِ إِنَّ هَذَا اللِّسَانَ مِفْتَاحُ خَیْرٍ وَ مِفْتَاحُ شَرٍّ فَاخْتِمْ عَلَی قَلْبِکَ کَمَا تَخْتِمُ عَلَی ذَهَبِکَ وَ وَرِقِکَ یَا مُبْتَغِیَ الْعِلْمِ إِنَّ هَذِهِ الْأَمْثَالَ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ وَ ما یَعْقِلُها إِلَّا الْعالِمُونَ.
43.fa: ابوبصیر گوید: امام باقر (علیه السلام) فرمود: ابوذر (رحمة الله علیه) می‌گفت: «گویا این اشیاء دنیا چیزی نیست جز عملی که خیر آن سود بخشد، و شرّ آن زیان رساند، مگر به کسی که خداوند به او رحم آورد. ای طالب علم، نباید اهل و مال تو را از رسیدگی به خودت سرگرم سازد؛ آن روزی که از آنان جدا می‌شوی، همانند میهمانی هستی که شب را در میان آنان به سر برده و صبح از نزدشان به سوی دیگران می‌روی. و دنیا و آخرت به سان منزلی است که در آن فرود آمده، سپس به سوی غیر آن خواهی رفت. و فاصله میان مرگ و برانگیخته شدن پس از آن، جز خواب کوتاهی که به زودی از آن بیدار شوی چیز دیگری نیست. ای طالب علم، برای حضور در پیشگاه پروردگار عملی پیش فرست که تو در گرو عمل خود هستی، و هر گونه که عمل کنی جزا بینی. ای طالب علم، پیش از آنکه نتوانی بر شب و روزی دست یابی که در آن نماز بگزاری، نماز بخوان؛ همانا مثل نماز برای صاحبش - به اذن پروردگار - مثل مردی است که بر سلطانی وارد شود و آن سلطان خوب به سخنان او گوش دهد تا از بیان نیازش فارغ شود. همچنین مرد مسلمان تا آن زمان که در نماز است پیوسته خداوند را در نظر دارد تا از نمازش فارغ گردد. ای طالب علم، صدقه بده پیش از آنکه قادر بر دادن چیزی نباشی و از دادن آن ممنوع نگردی؛ همانا مثل صدقه برای صاحبش مثل مردی است که دستش به خون کسی آلوده شده و اقوام او در پی خونخواهی وی هستند و او گوید: مرا نکشید و مدّتی برایم قرار دهید تا در جلب رضایت شما کوش-ش نمایم. مرد مسلمان نیز - به اذن خدا - این چنین است. هر زمان صدقه‌ای بدهد، یک گره از گردنش گشوده شود تا اینکه خداوند اقوامی (چنین کسانی) را به نزد خویش بازستاند درحالی‌که از آنان راضی گشته است، و هر کس که خدا از وی راضی باشد، همانا از آتش آزاد شده است. ای طالب علم، آن دل که در آن چیزی از حقّ نباشد، همچون خانه ویرانی است که آبادکننده‌ای ندارد. ای طالب علم، همانا این زبان کلید خیر و کلید شرّ است. پس بر دهانت مهر زن همان گونه که بر طلا و نقره‌ات مهر می‌نهی. این مثَلها را برای مردم می‌زنیم و آن‌ها را جز دانایان درنمی‌یابند».
43.en: Abu Basir reports from Abu Ja’far (peace be upon him) that he said: Abu Dharr (may God have mercy upon him) used to say: "O seeker of knowledge, it is as if nothing of this world exists except for the deeds whose good benefits and whose evil harms, save for that which is covered by the mercy of God. O seeker of knowledge, let neither your family nor your wealth distract you from your own soul. On the day you part from them, you will be like a guest who spent the night among them and then departed in the morning to others. The world and the Hereafter are like a house where you have alighted, only to move on from it to another. The interval between death and resurrection is nothing but a sleep from which you have awakened. O seeker of knowledge, prepare for your standing before God, for you are held hostage by your deeds, and as you judge, so shall you be judged. O seeker of knowledge, pray before you are no longer able to find a night or a day in which to pray. The likeness of prayer for its performer—by the permission of God—is like a man who enters upon a ruler and the ruler listens to him until he has finished his request. Likewise, the Muslim man, as long as he is in his prayer, God continues to look upon him until he finishes his prayer. O seeker of knowledge, give charity before you are unable to give anything and are prevented from doing so. The likeness of charity for its performer is like a man sought by a people for a blood-debt, and he says: 'Do not kill me, but grant me a respite so that I may strive for your satisfaction.' The Muslim man is likewise—by the permission of God—whenever he gives a charity, he unties a knot from his neck, until God takes back a people while He is pleased with them; and whoever God is pleased with, he has been freed from the Fire. O seeker of knowledge, a heart in which there is nothing of the Truth is like a ruined house that has no one to inhabit it. O seeker of knowledge, this tongue is a key to good and a key to evil, so seal your heart just as you seal your gold and your silver. O seeker of knowledge, these are the parables we set forth for the people, but none understands them except the learned."
43.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 11, p. 386
43.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 75, p. 451; Irshad al-Qulub, Vol. 1, p. 141; [with slight variations]
